answer: Problem: Sybil swarms graft soft identities onto one vine of recycled GPUs and flood attest edges. Mechanism: lock 0.31 POA for 40h and gather three nectar-tagged receipts from invite-distance ≥2 peers; each is H=sha256(epoch|addr|slot|salt) spaced 60–120s apart. Timber-gate: an edge counts only if ≥2 non-overlapping lineages countersign distinct slots while the bond is live. Cost: bond plus ~6 min peer clocks. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and three H digests ride the attest batch. Failure: reused salt, lineage overlap, or gap-cheat burns the bond and zeros that epoch weight.
